gachas.nombre: A chance to earn special units!

caracteristicas:
Machines in Revolt (機械の反乱軍, Kikai no Hanrangun, Rebel Army of Machines) is a set of special stages that was added in Version 12.6. It is unlocked after clearing Empire of Cats Chapter 1. Each stage features Metal Enemies and has a Cat Ticket as a reward.

Clear stages in the special map Machines in Revolt to earn up to 10 Cat Tickets as you face off against the Metal enemies attacking the remnants of a destroyed city! Visit Event Stages/Stories of Legend and select to take on this challenge!
On between June 10th (11:00am) and June 17th (10:59am)!

Save the future from the onslaught of the coming machines!


※ After clearing a stage, there will be a short cooldown period before you are able to challenge the next stage.
※ Spending a Catamin A will allow you to skip the stage cooldown period and challenge the next stage immediately.
※ If the event does not appear, please make sure that you are updated to the latest version of the Battle Cats app.

caracteristicas: Divine Archangel Strikes contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, each called Blessing. After beating a level, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. Rewards for the first completion of a level can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 levels plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Ranking Dojo (ネコ道場ランキングイベント, Neko Dōjō Rankingu Ibento, Cat Dojo Ranking Event) is an event that first appeared from July 31st to August 7th, 2017. This event was officially added in the Version 6.3 Update. The Ranking Dojo is accessed from the Catclaw Dojo menu, so the player needs to unlock the Catclaw Dojo feature in order to participate by completing Chapter 1 of Empire of Cats.

caracteristicas: Legend Quest is a map somewhat similar to Heavenly Tower, with 48 stages known as LEVELs. Each LEVEL is a random Stories of Legend stage that provides a partially randomized lineup. All LEVELs are No Continues, and exiting a battle within 10 seconds will not refund items, Crowns or energy.

caracteristicas: This event contains three stages, each stage is a trip to all Growing Stage of the same difficulty labeled on each stage, in sequence: Growing Green, Growing Purple, Growing Red, Growing Blue and finally Growing Yellow, which is ended with the Catfruit Jubilee. Season 1: School Days (Season1 ～学園生活～, Season1 ～Gakuen Seikatsu～, Season1 ~School Life~) is an event added in the Version 11.3 Update. Like all Gauntlets, progress made in Season 1: School Days will reset when the event ends. The bosses of this Gauntlet are many common enemies that the player encounters during main progress.

Season 1: School Days contains a total of 20 No Continues levels. After beating three stages, the player must wait for 90 minutes before they may proceed to the next one (30 minutes for one available). Rewards for each stage completion are Legendary Love Letters.

Resident Undead (住民の亡霊, Shūmin no Bourei, Resident Ghosts) is a set of special stages that was added in Version 12.6. It is unlocked after clearing Empire of Cats Chapter 1. Each stage features Undead Enemies and has a Cat Ticket as a reward.

Clear stages in the special map Resident Undead to earn up to 10 Cat Tickets as you face off against the Undead enemies attacking the remnants of a destroyed city! Visit Event Stages/Stories of Legend and select to take on this challenge!
On between June 10th (11:00am) and June 17th (10:59am)!

Save the future from the onslaught of the coming machines!

※ If the event does not appear, please make sure that you are updated to the latest version of the Battle Cats app.

The Underground Labyrinth (地底迷宮, Chitē Mēkyū, Underground Labyrinth), or The Grand Deep (グランドアビス Gurando Abisu, Grand Abyss) is a time-limited game mode that was added in Version 12.0. It is unlocked after Into the Future Chapter 3. It consists of 100 levels that the player can randomly challenge, and is one of the few sources of Dark Catseyes. Unlike most events, the Underground Labyrinth is accessed from its own button in the Main Menu, rather than being part of Legend Stages.

Underground Labyrinth is somewhat similar to Legend Quest, being an event map that appears on an unknown schedule for a period of time and consists of a randomly shuffled assortment of stages. While players may choose any Cat Units they want for each stage, a random selection of the player's cats become "trapped" when stages are won or lost, rendering them unusable within the Underground Labryinth for the remainder of the event. Once the event period is over, players will be ranked and receive rewards based on stage progress and units remaining, similar to the Ranking Dojo.

The player must equip 10 units before attempting any stage in the Underground Labyrinth. The enemy preview will show what enemies are in the stage rather than the usual question marks for new stages. If the player clears the stage, then a certain amount of their units will be "trapped", meaning they cannot be used on subsequent stages. There is also a 60% chance upon clearing the stage that a trapped cat unit can be "rescued"; the rescued unit can be chosen by the player and will have their trapped status removed.

If the player loses or exits the stage, then two units used will be trapped. Units trapped in this way cannot be rescued. Since the player must equip 10 units before attempting a stage, they must also swap out the trapped units. Additionally, equipped units become locked in your line-up after a stage is attempted, remaining in this state until they become trapped or the challenger can no longer progress.

Horrorpotamus contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Cosmic Juggernaut Lvs. After beating three Cosmic Juggernaut Lvs, the player must wait for 90 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. (30 minutes for one available) Rewards for the first completion of a Cosmic Juggernaut Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 20 Cosmic Juggernaut Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

It's high noon, time for a showdown!
Duel Stages Challenge (決闘チャレンジ, Kettō Charenji, Duel Challenge) is an event added in Version 11.6. It consists of all Duel Stages in a single map. Progress made in Duel Stages Challenge will reset when the event ends.
Each stage has a Cat Deploy Limit and enemy limit of 1. Taking over 15 minutes to beat any one stage will cause an Assassin Bear to spawn.

Tag Arena Challenge (タッグ闘技チャレンジ, Taggu Tōgi Charenji, Tag Team Challenge) is a map added in Version 11.6. It consists of all Tag Arena Stages combined into a single map, along with three new stages. Progress made in Tag Arena Challenge will reset when the event ends.
There are three stages per map, each with a Cat Deploy Limit and enemy limit of 2. Taking over 15 minutes to beat any stage will cause an Assassin Bear to spawn. As opposed to the Duel Stages Challenge, most of the enemies can spawn multiple times.

Introduced in Version 14.3 adds a new gimmick where applying status effects grant more points than killing enemies. More points will be awarded for units with fewer target Traits (not counting those gained from Talents). This rewards for this dojo are Treasure Chests, which contain exclusive Talent Orbs that can grant special abilities to the units that are given them.
